title: Trump Was in Very Good Spirits at Meeting, Sheinbaum Says. They Made Progress on Trade
author: Redacción/SinEmbargo
content:
_This article
by[Redacción/SinEmbargo](https://www.sinembargo.mx/author/redaccion/)
originally appeared in the [November 18, 2026 edition of
SinEmbargo](https://www.sinembargo.mx/4905700/sheinbaum-sostiene-muy-buena-
reunion-con-trump-en-china-avanzan-en-la-agenda-comun/), a Mexican digital
news outlet._

_The Mexican president had already announced that she would hold a brief
meeting with Trump during the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC)
Leaders’ Summit._

**Mexico City, November 18 (SinEmbargo).-** **President[Claudia Sheinbaum
Pardo](https://www.sinembargo.mx/4905629/sheinbaum-se-reune-con-el-presidente-
de-vietnam-conversan-sobre-comercio-y-apec-2027/)** held a meeting with her US
counterpart, **Donald Trump** , as part of her agenda of activities in
**China.** The president described the meeting as “very good.”

> “We held a very good meeting with [President Donald
> Trump](https://www.sinembargo.mx/4903857/la-popularidad-de-trump-cae-a-su-
> peor-nivel-mas-analistas-creen-son-malas-noticias/) and his team. We
> continue to make progress on our shared agenda,” Sheinbaum reported on
> social media in a post in which she shared a photograph of the conversation.

The day before, the head of the federal executive branch had announced that
she would hold a “brief meeting with the president of the United States,” who
is also in the Asian country for the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC)
Leaders’ Summit 2026, being held in Shenzhen.

> [Post by @Claudiashein on
> X](https://x.com/Claudiashein/status/2123030573178671317)

## The President Attends Banquet and Official Photo Sessions

In addition to meeting with Trump, Sheinbaum also attended the APEC Leaders’
Banquet hosted by Chinese President Xi Jinping. Upon her arrival, the Mexican
president was welcomed with the song “Cielito lindo,” performed live by an
orchestra of eight people.

The president’s activities also included participating in official photo
sessions with her Chinese counterpart and first lady Peng Liyuan, as well as
the other leaders of the countries participating in APEC.

On Tuesday, Sheinbaum Pardo said that her visit to the Asian giant represents
“a new era in relations between Mexico and China, a relationship that is the
result of deep bonds of friendship and shared principles, such as cooperation
for development and shared prosperity.”

![Claudia Sheinbaum stands with other APEC leaders for an official group
photograph.](https://mexicosolidarity.com/wp-
content/uploads/2026/11/sheinbaum-trump-china-meeting-inline-1.jpg)President
Claudia Sheinbaum participated in the APEC 2026 leaders’ family photograph.
Photo: Presidency.

## Sheinbaum Meets with Vietnam’s President

On her third day of activities in Shenzhen, China, during her visit to Asia-
Pacific Economic Cooperation, Sheinbaum also met with Vietnamese President Tô
Lâm.

On social media, Mexico’s government shared images of the meeting between the
Mexican president and the general secretary of the Communist Party of Vietnam.

> “During the meeting, the two leaders highlighted the strength of the
> bilateral relationship, which in 2026 marks 51 years since its
> establishment, and expressed their interest in deepening political and
> economic ties,” Mexico’s government reported through the Secretariat of
> Foreign Affairs (SRE).

> [Post by @GobiernoMX on
> X](https://x.com/GobiernoMX/status/2122913281874473160)

The SRE also noted that Sheinbaum and her Vietnamese counterpart discussed
opportunities to boost bilateral trade, increase investment and “facilitate
access for Mexican products to the Vietnamese market.”

“They also recognized the importance of expanding cooperation between Mexico
and Vietnam in multilateral forums and strengthening ties between Latin
America and Asia-Pacific,” the federal agency said.
